title: Frobenius structure on rigid connections and arithmetic applications
summary: We construct the natural Frobenius structures on two families of rigid irregular $\check{G}$-connections on $\mathbb{G}_m$ (or $\mathbb{A}^1$) for a split simple group $\check{G}$: (i) the $θ$-connections arising from Vinberg's $θ$-groups introduced by Chen and Yun; (ii) the Airy connection of Jakob--Kamgarpour--Yi generalizing the classical Airy equations. These data form the $p$-adic companions of the $\ell$-adic local systems introduced by Yun and Jakob--Kamgarpour--Yi.
